# A-ROSA Cruises

> > A-ROSA Cruises offers European river cruises on the Danube, Rhine, Seine, Rhône, and Douro rivers with premium ships and all-inclusive experiences.

A-ROSA operates a modern fleet including the sustainable E-Motion Ship A-ROSA SENA, offering river cruise vacations departing from major European cities like Porto, Paris, Cologne, Amsterdam, and Passau. The company provides comprehensive cruise packages with hotel extensions, shore excursions, and wellness amenities across Portugal, France, Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands.
